**Limitations**

- This is PixelNexus's own code after the paper, not SURF itself. It computes responses at every pixel and has no subpixel refinement, so positions and sizes are coarser than in SURF.
- The descriptor is not built.
- A blob can be found in two octaves, since the filter sizes of neighboring octaves overlap.
- On a round blob, the angle only roughly follows the brightness around it. On a disk on a ramp, it is within about 30 degrees of the direction of the ramp.

**Artifacts**

- Many keypoints along fine, high-contrast patterns, such as the spokes of the Siemens star.
